studies.name: sma
studies.label: SMA
studies.convention: Arithmetic mean of adjusted close over `period` bars.

studies.name: ema
studies.label: EMA
studies.convention: EMA with alpha = 2/(period+1), adjust=False, on adjusted close.

studies.name: rsi
studies.label: RSI
studies.convention: Wilder's RSI: gains and losses smoothed with alpha=1/period (not span=period), on adjusted close. Matches EODHD to 1.5e-5.

studies.name: bbands
studies.label: Bollinger Bands
studies.convention: Middle = SMA(period) of adjusted close. Bands = mid +/- k * population standard deviation (ddof=0). Matches EODHD to 1.2e-7.

studies.name: atr
studies.label: ATR
studies.convention: Wilder's average of true range on RAW OHLC. EODHD's atr matches raw, not adjusted -- feeding adjusted close here is a 96% error (spec S5).

studies.name: wma
studies.label: WMA
studies.convention: Linearly weighted mean of adjusted close; weight i = i for i in 1..period.

studies.name: keltner
studies.label: Keltner Channels
studies.convention: EMA(period) of adjusted close +/- mult * Wilder ATR(atr_period) of raw OHLC.

studies.name: donchian
studies.label: Price Channels
studies.convention: Highest high and lowest low of raw OHLC over `period` bars; mid is their mean.

studies.name: vwap
studies.label: VWAP
studies.convention: Cumulative typical-price-weighted mean over the whole window (not session-anchored). Typical price = (H+L+C)/3 on raw OHLC.

studies.name: avwap
studies.label: Anchored VWAP
studies.convention: Cumulative TRADE-weighted mean from the anchor timestamp forward: sum(price*size)/sum(size) over actual trades, via each tick-derived bar's own vwap column (size wavg price in q). Bars without trade data -- vendor history, bars before the anchor -- are null; this never falls back to a typical-price approximation. Anchor is an ISO-8601 instant or OBS-n (a naive instant is UTC). No anchor = cumulative from the first bar with trade data.

studies.name: volume
studies.label: Volume
studies.convention: Raw bar volume, drawn as bars.

studies.name: macd
studies.label: MACD
studies.convention: EMA(fast) - EMA(slow) on adjusted close; signal is EMA(signal) of that line.

studies.name: stoch
studies.label: Stochastic
studies.convention: smooth_k=1 is FAST %K, 3 is SLOW, anything else is FULL. Raw OHLC. EODHD and pandas_ta both return SLOW under the bare name 'k' (spec S4, S6) -- this default is fast, and stated.

studies.name: stochrsi
studies.label: StochRSI
studies.convention: Stochastic of Wilder RSI(period) over stoch_period bars, scaled 0-100, on adjusted close.

studies.name: adx
studies.label: ADX / DMI
studies.convention: Wilder's ADX on raw OHLC: +DM/-DM smoothed with alpha=1/period, divided by Wilder ATR, then DX smoothed again.

studies.name: cci
studies.label: CCI
studies.convention: (typical price - SMA) / (0.015 * mean absolute deviation), raw OHLC. MAD is taken about the rolling mean, not the rolling median.

studies.name: willr
studies.label: Williams %R
studies.convention: -100 * (highest high - close) / (highest high - lowest low), raw OHLC.

studies.name: roc
studies.label: Rate of Change
studies.convention: Percent change of adjusted close over `period` bars.

studies.name: obv
studies.label: On Balance Volume
studies.convention: Running sum of signed volume; sign from the adjusted close change.

studies.name: stddev
studies.label: Standard Deviation
studies.convention: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of adjusted close.

studies.name: pct_b
studies.label: %B
studies.convention: (close - lower) / (upper - lower), on adjusted close. Shares Bollinger's bases exactly.

studies.name: bandwidth
studies.label: Bollinger BandWidth
studies.convention: (upper - lower) / middle * 100, on adjusted close. Shares Bollinger's bases exactly.

studies.name: sar
studies.label: Parabolic SAR
studies.convention: Wilder's Parabolic SAR on raw OHLC. Path-dependent: the value at each bar carries the extreme point and acceleration factor forward, so it cannot be a Polars expression.

studies.name: hma
studies.label: Hull Moving Average
studies.convention: WMA(2*WMA(adj_close, round(n/2)) - WMA(adj_close, n), round(sqrt(n))). Both derived lengths are rounded to nearest, not truncated.
studies.desc: Halves WMA lag: WMA of (2·WMA(n/2) − WMA(n)) over √n bars.
studies.description: Combines two weighted moving averages of different lengths to cancel out lag while keeping the line smooth, so it tracks price closely without the choppiness of a plain fast average. A turn in its slope is read as an early trend-change signal.

studies.name: trix
studies.label: TRIX
studies.convention: 1-bar percent change of a triple EMA(period) on adjusted close, alpha = 2/(period+1) matching the plain `ema` indicator. fill_nan(None): the EMA can be exactly zero, making the percent change 0/0.
studies.description: The percentage rate of change of a price average that has been smoothed three times over, which strips out short-term noise more aggressively than a single moving average. Crossing above or below zero is read as a shift in the longer-term trend's direction.

studies.name: supertrend
studies.label: Supertrend
studies.convention: Wilder ATR(period)-banded trailing stop on raw OHLC. The band only tightens until close crosses it, then the side flips. Path-dependent like Parabolic SAR, so it runs in the iterative pass.
studies.desc: ATR-banded trailing stop; flips on close-through.
studies.description: A single trailing line set a multiple of average true range away from price, holding steady on one side until price closes through it. A flip in which side of price the line sits on is read as a change in trend direction.

studies.name: ao
studies.label: Awesome Oscillator
studies.convention: SMA(HL2, 5) - SMA(HL2, 34) on raw high/low. Fixed periods (Bill Williams).
studies.description: The difference between a short and a long simple average of the midpoint of each bar's high and low, plotted as a histogram around zero. Bars switching from below to above zero, or a change in the bars' color, are read as a shift in short-term momentum.

studies.name: mfi
studies.label: Money Flow Index
studies.convention: Typical price (H+L+C)/3, raw money flow = TP*volume, bucketed by the sign of TP.diff() and summed over `period` bars. A window with no typical-price movement is null, not 0 and not NaN.
studies.description: Combines price and volume into a single 0-100 oscillator, similar to RSI but weighting each bar's contribution by how much volume traded on it. High readings are read as overbought and low readings as oversold, with more weight given to heavy-volume moves.

studies.name: cmf
studies.label: Chaikin Money Flow
studies.convention: Sum of money-flow multiplier * volume over `period` bars, divided by summed volume. Flat bars (high == low) contribute 0, not NaN.
studies.desc: Money-flow volume ÷ volume over N bars.
studies.description: Measures whether volume over the lookback window is concentrated on bars that closed near their high or near their low, summed and scaled by total volume. Sustained positive readings are read as accumulation and sustained negative readings as distribution.

studies.name: uo
studies.label: Ultimate Oscillator
studies.convention: Weighted blend of buying-pressure / true-range sum-ratios at three windows, weights 4:2:1, divisor 7. BP = close - min(low, prior close). Ratio of sums, not mean of ratios. fill_nan(None) suffices here: TR_t == 0 forces close_t == close_{t-1}, which forces buying_t == 0 too, so a zero-TR window is always 0/0 (NaN), never x/0.
studies.description: Blends buying pressure measured over three different lookback lengths into one 0-100 reading, weighting the shortest window most heavily so it reacts quickly while still reflecting the longer-term picture. High readings are read as overbought and low readings as oversold.

studies.name: vortex
studies.label: Vortex Indicator
studies.convention: VM+ = |high - prior low|, VM- = |low - prior high|, each summed over `period` bars and divided by summed true range. The tr base is period-independent, keyed tr:raw:0.
studies.description: Compares how far price has moved up against the prior bar's low to how far it has moved down against the prior bar's high, plotted as two lines. Whichever line crosses above the other is read as the currently dominant trend direction.

studies.name: chop
studies.label: Choppiness Index
studies.convention: 100 * log10(sum(TR, n) / (highest high - lowest low)) / log10(n) on raw OHLC. A range/trendiness gauge, not a directional one -- high is choppy, low is trending. span == 0 forces every in-window bar to the same price, so span > 0 implies the summed true range is too -- the `span > 0` guard fully closes the divide-by-zero case.
studies.desc: Range vs trend gauge, not directional.
studies.description: Measures whether price is trending or moving sideways by comparing the sum of daily ranges to the overall range of the lookback window, scaled between zero and one hundred. A high reading is read as a choppy, non-trending market, while a low reading suggests a sustained directional move.

studies.name: ichimoku
studies.label: Ichimoku Cloud
studies.convention: Tenkan/Kijun/Senkou B from rolling high-low midpoints on raw OHLC. Values sit at the row they are COMPUTED from; the leading spans and Chikou are displaced via render['time_offset'], never by shifting the column. That offset is fixed at the default `displacement` (26) -- a non-default `displacement` moves the midpoint windows but plots the result at the same default offset (see render below).
studies.desc: Displaced cloud — rendered server-side in this build.
studies.description: A cluster of lines built from rolling highs and lows at three different lengths, plus the current close and a shaded cloud between two of the lines. Price relative to the cloud is read as the trend's direction, and the cloud's thickness is read as the strength of support or resistance ahead.

studies.name: pivots_standard
studies.label: Pivot Points Standard
studies.convention: Classic floor pivots from the PRIOR session's high/low/close, held flat across the current session. group_by_dynamic(every=anchor) -> shift(session_shift) -> join_asof(backward). The first session has no prior and is null, not zero.
studies.desc: Prior-session floor pivots, held flat — server-side.
studies.description: Projects support and resistance levels for the current session from the prior session's high, low, and close, drawn as flat lines. Price approaching one of these levels is read as a likely area where the move may pause or reverse.

studies.name: ratio
studies.label: RATIO
studies.convention: adj_close / vs_adj_close on the dates both tickers have; a date either lacks is a gap.
studies.desc: Adjusted close ÷ the other ticker's adjusted close.
studies.description: Divides this ticker's price by another's on every date both trade, so a rising line means this one is outperforming the other and a falling line means it is lagging behind.

studies.name: spread
studies.label: SPREAD
studies.convention: adj_close - multiple * vs_adj_close on shared dates.
studies.desc: Adjusted close − multiple × the other ticker's adjusted close.
studies.description: Subtracts a multiple of another ticker's price from this one's on every shared date, the classic pairs spread; it crosses zero where the two stand in the chosen balance.

studies.name: corr
studies.label: CORR
studies.convention: Pearson correlation of 100*pct_change(adj_close) and 100*pct_change(vs_adj_close) over `period` shared bars.
studies.desc: Correlation of the two tickers' daily returns over N shared bars.
studies.description: Measures how closely the two tickers' bar-to-bar returns move together over the window, from minus one (opposite) through zero (unrelated) to one (in lockstep).

studies.name: beta
studies.label: BETA
studies.convention: rolling sample cov(r, r_vs) / rolling sample var(r_vs) over `period` shared bars, r = 100*pct_change(adj_close).
studies.desc: Covariance of the returns ÷ variance of the other's returns, over N shared bars.
studies.description: Estimates how far this ticker tends to move for each one percent the other moves over the window; one means it moves with it, above one more, below one less.

studies.name: retdiff
studies.label: RETDIFF
studies.convention: 100*pct_change(adj_close) - 100*pct_change(vs_adj_close) on shared bars.
studies.desc: This ticker's 1-bar return minus the other's, as a histogram.
studies.description: Shows, bar by bar, how much more or less this ticker returned than the other one, so runs of bars above zero mark stretches where it kept outperforming.

studies.name: relret
studies.label: RELRET
studies.convention: (adj_close / adj_close@anchor) / (vs_adj_close / vs_adj_close@anchor) - 1; null before the anchor.
studies.desc: Return since the anchor relative to the other ticker's; no anchor is the first shared bar.
studies.description: Rebases both tickers to the anchor date and shows how far this one has gained or lost against the other since then, as a fraction where 0.05 means five percent ahead.

studies.name: returns
studies.label: RETURNS
studies.convention: r = 100*pct_change(adj_close), r_vs = 100*pct_change(vs_adj_close) on shared bars.
studies.desc: Both tickers' 1-bar percent returns, as two lines.
studies.description: Draws each ticker's bar-to-bar percent return on the dates both trade, so a reader can see side by side which one moved more on any given day.

studies.name: zscore
studies.label: ZSCORE
studies.convention: (x - rolling_mean(x, period)) / rolling_std(x, period, ddof=1), x = ratio or adj_close - multiple * vs_adj_close.
studies.desc: How many standard deviations the ratio or spread sits from its N-bar mean.
studies.description: Standardises the price ratio or spread against its own recent mean and spread, so readings beyond two in either direction flag an unusually stretched relationship between the pair.

studies.name: qualification_delta
studies.label: Qualification delta
studies.convention: Custom study qualification_delta.
